title: Three Women in Winter Coats in Snowy Yard, 1943 Vintage Snapshot Photo
description: A charming snapshot from December 1943 showing three women of varying ages standing outdoors in a snow-covered yard in front of a Spanish stucco-style house. The young woman in the center wears glasses, a tied headscarf, and a tweed belted coat over a floral patterned dress, while the woman to her left wears a dark winter coat with styled hair, and the older woman to the right stands poised in a pleated overcoat with a dark fur collar. Taken during the World War II home-front era, the photograph captures everyday wartime domestic life and seasonal winter fashion.
